LU-20428 lod: init fld range type before lod_fld_lookup

Initialize fld range type to LU_SEQ_RANGE_MDT properly in
lod_dir_layout_check() before calling lod_fld_lookup() to
avoid passing any garbage into fld_range_set_type().
